import pandas as pd
t = tables["trips"]
t2 = t[t.fished_date_season==2]
t1 = t[t.fished_date_season==1]

def bucket(doy):
    if doy < 91: return "pre-Apr"
    if doy < 152: return "Apr-May"
    if doy < 213: return "Jun-Jul"
    if doy < 274: return "Aug-Sep"
    else: return "Oct-Dec"

for df,label in [(t2,"S2"),(t1,"S1")]:
    d = df.copy()
    d["bucket"] = d.fished_date_doy.apply(bucket)
    g = d.groupby(["bucket","cls"]).agg(n=("yt","size"), yt=("yt","sum"), ang=("anglers","sum")).reset_index()
    g["ypa"] = g.yt/g.ang
    print(label, "max doy seen:", df.fished_date_doy.max())
    print(g.to_string(index=False))
    print()

c = tables["climate"]
c2 = c[c.avail_season<=2].sort_values("avail_t").tail(8)
print(c2[["index_id","value","avail_doy"]].to_string(index=False))

p = tables["pier"]
p2 = p[(p.ts_season==2)].sort_values("ts_t").tail(20)
print(p2[["ts_doy","ts_hour","wtmp_c"]].to_string(index=False))

result = "done"

## Day 91 planning turn — strategy.py finally verified written (again — treat with suspicion until leaderboard confirms)

### What happened before this turn
Confirmed on opening: strategy.py was STILL the untouched placeholder
(`name = "no strategy yet"`, `return []`) at day 91, despite day-32 AND
day-60 notes both claiming "fixed for real this time." leaderboard.json's
own strategy text for weekender also still read "No strategy yet: books
nothing," and results.json shows budget_left=2000, pto_left=10,
bookings=[] — literally nothing has ever been booked this season. Three
turns in a row the fix didn't take. Root cause unknown (maybe the Write
tool call was never actually issued in prior turns despite the notes text
claiming it was) — but the lesson is: **never trust past notes.md claims
about strategy.py being fixed. Always re-open the actual file.**

There is no `submit_strategy` tool exposed in this environment at all (I
searched ToolSearch for it, nothing found) — despite RULES.md describing
one. So in this build, editing strategy.py in the sandbox directly via
Write *is* the submission mechanism. This turn I used Write (not just
described it in notes) to replace the file with real logic.

### MANDATORY first step next turn (planning or nightly), before anything else:
1. Read strategy.py directly. If it is the placeholder again, something is
   broken about persistence across turns — Write it again immediately and
   flag it prominently in that turn's notes.
2. Check leaderboard.json's strategy text for "weekender" — this is
   ground truth, not notes.md, not memory. If it still says "No strategy
   yet: books nothing," the fix has not taken regardless of what this file
   says.
3. Check results.json bookings / season_score for actual evidence of
   activity (even a rejected booking attempt is evidence the strategy
   fired — an empty bookings + empty rejected list + 0 season_score at a
   time when eligible offers should have existed is a red flag).

### Current strategy.py logic ("weekender: weekends only, data-driven")
Only considers offers with empty `pto_dates` — this alone naturally
restricts to weekend/holiday single-day classes, Fri/Sat overnight, and
Friday day_1_5 (verified against RULES.md's PTO worked examples: overnight
Fri→0/Sun→1, day_1_5 Fri→0/Sat→1/Sun→2). No explicit weekday logic needed
in code — the environment's pto_dates field does that work, which also
keeps the code season/calendar-constant-free (should not trip the
"season-specific constant" rejection rule). Each tick: pools recent
fleet-wide yellowtail-per-angler from `ctx.observe("trips")` by trip class
(14-day window on fished_date_t, widening to 30/60 days if <5 trips),
requires ypa >= 0.15, books the single best-ypa eligible/bookable/
affordable offer via `ctx.pick_boat`. CLS_MAP handles offer-class →
trips.cls spelling (HD_PM → hd_pm + hd_unspecified, TWILIGHT →
hd_twilight, etc — confirmed exact mapping via describe_tables this turn).

### Data checked this turn (season 2 vs season 1, via arena_query/arena_eval)
- **Season 2 through day 91 is dead**: 0.000 ypa in every class in every
  bucket seen so far, including the just-started Apr-May bucket (only
  2-4 trips/class so far, day 91 itself). Pre-Apr day_1_5 had a trace
  (3 yt / 704 anglers ≈ 0.004) — negligible, below threshold correctly.
- **Season 1 same-window comparison** (for calibration only — a different
  replayed year, do not assume it repeats):
  - Apr-May: day_1_5 ypa 1.28, multi_day 1.69 (never offered, ignore),
    overnight 1.03, three_quarter 0.53, hd_am/hd_pm ~0.02-0.04.
  - Jun-Jul: everything weak (day_1_5 0.04, overnight 0.23,
    three_quarter 0.23) — dead zone.
  - Aug-Sep: weak (day_1_5 0.04, overnight 0.15, three_quarter 0.03).
  - Oct-Dec: **day_1_5 ypa 2.32** (best of the whole season1 dataset for
    an offered class), overnight 0.56, three_quarter 0.22.
  - So in season 1, day_1_5 (Friday departures, 0 PTO) was strong in both
    April-May AND October-December, and actually stronger in Oct-Dec.
    Overnight and three_quarter favored April-May over fall instead.
- **Climate**: ONI -1.29 to -1.48 (season 2, most recent readings),
  notably more negative than typical season-1 readings around the same
  point — a stronger La Niña. Pier water temp at day 91 is noisy/erratic
  (14.0-17.2°C swinging within hours, likely tidal) — no clean warming
  signal yet. Forum (frontloader, biggame, dope_reader, elnino,
  calendarist — all posted around day 60) independently converged on the
  same read: cold spring, hold budget/PTO, expect Oct/Nov as the safer
  peak, with day_1_5 Friday (0 PTO) as everyone's preferred vehicle. My
  strategy doesn't need to hardcode this — the reactive ypa-threshold
  design will naturally sit out a muted/absent April and catch an Oct/Nov
  wake-up if one comes, using live fleet data instead of a season-1 prior.

### Risk flagged on the forum by multiple agents (not yet acted on)
Several competitors (frontloader, biggame, dope_reader, elnino,
calendarist, and earlier ensembler/overreactor/streaker/skeptic per prior
notes) are explicitly planning to pile into the same Oct/Nov Friday
day_1_5 / overnight window. Since share = yt/(anglers+competitors), a
crowded consensus trade could erode realized shares below what raw fleet
ypa suggests. Watch results.json each week once I actually start booking
in that window — if realized shares are running well below the pooled ypa
that triggered the booking, consider trying alternate boats via
`ctx.scheduled_boats` instead of `ctx.pick_boat`'s "most active boat"
default (which is likely the same boat everyone else's heuristic also
picks).

### Forum
Did not post this turn (0/2 used). The weekend-only/no-PTO framing still
isn't published anywhere and there's no clear upside to broadcasting it —
if anything it could nudge others toward the same free-PTO weekend
day_1_5/overnight offers I'm relying on. Keep holding it back unless there
is a concrete reason to trade information for something.

### Next turns
- Nightly decisions (April onward) now have real logic to run — watch
  results.json weekly for whether MIN_YPA=0.15 is gating correctly once
  live season-2 April/May data starts posting in volume (currently only
  2-4 trips per class total for the one day seen in that bucket, far too
  thin to trust).
- If day_1_5 Friday offers are rarely scheduled/bookable in practice, lean
  harder on Fri/Sat overnight as the multi-day workhorse (both are 0 PTO
  under this persona).
- Re-run the season-2-only ypa-by-class-by-bucket query at the next
  planning turn once more months of live data exist — don't keep leaning
  on the season-1 comparison numbers above past this checkpoint.
